search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/iis* webserver_system=iis Win32_PerfFormattedData_W3SVC_WebService
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as iis_log_message
| parse field=iis_log_message "Name = \"*\";" as Name nodrop
| parse field=iis_log_message "BytesReceivedPersec = \"*\";" as BytesReceivedPersec nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "BytesSentPersec = \"*\";" as BytesSentPersec nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "BytesTotalPersec = \"*\";" as BytesTotalPersec nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "CGIRequestsPersec = *;" as CGIRequestsPersec nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "CurrentAnonymousUsers = *;" as CurrentAnonymousUsers nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "CurrentConnections = *;" as CurrentConnections nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "CurrentNonAnonymousUsers = *;" as CurrentNonAnonymousUsers nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "FilesReceivedPersec = *;" as FilesReceivedPersec nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "FilesSentPersec = *;" as FilesSentPersec nodrop
| parse	field=iis_log_message "GetRequestsPersec = *;" as GetRequestsPersec nodrop
| parse	"ISAPIExtensionRequestsPersec = *;" as GetRequestsPersec nodrop
| parse	"PostRequestsPersec = *;" as PostRequestsPersec nodrop
| parse	"ServiceUptime = *;" as ServiceUptime nodrop
| parse "TotalMethodRequestsPersec = *;" as TotalMethodRequestsPersec nodrop
